row.reason: Paylocity sells a cloud HCM, payroll and HR platform to employers, with payroll tax filing. eGain sells AI knowledge management and customer service automation software to enterprise and government contact centers. The two share only a SaaS subscription model. Their products are unrelated, and the buyers are different: HR and finance teams at mid-sized employers versus customer service organizations at large enterprises.
